name: Campaign Sandbox
description: End-to-end campaign strategy workflow. Takes a messy brief, extracts strategic tension, generates and stress-tests multiple campaign routes, prompts human selection, then produces a full execution plan.

nodes.label: Messy Brief Intake
nodes.description: Accepts an unstructured campaign brief as raw text input. No validation at this stage — all inputs are accepted.

nodes.label: Normalize Brief
nodes.description: Parses and normalizes the raw brief into structured fields: goals, target_audience, budget_range, timeline, constraints, and success_metrics. Flags ambiguous or missing fields.

nodes.label: Extract Strategic Tension
nodes.description: Identifies the core strategic tension in the brief — e.g. growth vs. margin, brand vs. performance, short-term vs. long-term. This tension anchors all generated routes.

nodes.label: Generate Routes
nodes.description: Generates three distinct campaign route options based on the normalized brief and strategic tension. Each route has a name, hypothesis, target segment, channel mix, and key risk.

nodes.label: Build Personas
nodes.description: Builds 2–3 target buyer personas from the normalized brief. Each persona has a job title, decision criteria, buying cycle, objection patterns, and communication preferences.

nodes.label: Simulate Persona Reactions
nodes.description: Simulates each persona's reaction to each campaign route. Produces predicted engagement level, conversion likelihood, and qualitative commentary per persona × route combination.

nodes.label: Score Routes
nodes.description: Scores each route across four dimensions: persona resonance (from simulation), brand fit, feasibility (timeline × budget), and strategic tension alignment. Produces a ranked leaderboard.

nodes.label: Premortem Review
nodes.description: Adversarially stress-tests the top-ranked route. Assumes it failed and works backward to identify the most likely failure modes, blind spots, and execution risks.

nodes.label: Compare Routes
nodes.description: Assembles the final comparison view: routes with scores, persona simulation results, and premortem findings. Formats output for human review.

nodes.label: Human Route Selection
nodes.description: Presents the route comparison to the user. Requires explicit human selection of one route before execution planning proceeds. The run blocks here until selection is received.

nodes.label: Generate Execution Plan
nodes.description: Generates a detailed 90-day execution plan for the selected route. Includes channel-by-channel tactics, budget allocation guidance, milestone schedule, and success KPIs.

nodes.label: Campaign Recommendation Export
nodes.description: Packages the selected route, execution plan, persona insights, and premortem findings into a structured JSON report artifact.
